create.name: John P. Milton
create.bio:
John P. Milton is an ecologist turned meditation teacher who has spent most of his life leading people into wild places to practise alone. He trained in ecology at the University of Michigan in the early 1960s, then worked on the environmental effects of international development, helped start Friends of the Earth and wrote several early books on the subject. Alongside that career he studied with teachers from many traditions, among them a Lacandon Maya elder in Chiapas, the Tibetan masters Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche and Lopon Tenzin Namdak, and the T'ai Chi teacher Ben Lo.

Out of this he shaped Way of Nature, a path built on twelve guiding principles that he calls natural liberation. Its core programme is Sacred Passage: about twelve days that combine awareness training, qigong-style energy practice and a week of solo time in the wilderness. Shorter Nature Quests and long solo retreats of 28 or 44 days build on it. His book Sky Above, Earth Below sets out the practices for readers. Way of Nature is run from Crestone, Colorado, and he guides retreats with senior guides in the American Southwest, Baja California and elsewhere.

books.title: Sky Above, Earth Below: Spiritual Practice in Nature
books.author: John P. Milton
books.description: His handbook for practising in the natural world, setting out the twelve principles behind Way of Nature and then working through relaxation, presence and energy cultivation step by step.

courses.title: Sacred Passage: Chiricahua Mountains, Arizona
courses.description: A twelve-day retreat in the Chiricahua canyons led by John P. Milton with guide Brad Kahland. Group awareness training prepares participants for seven days of solo time in nature and helps them settle back afterwards.

courses.title: Sacred Passage: Baja California, Mexico
courses.description: The same foundational retreat held on the Pacific coast of the Baja peninsula, led by Milton alongside his senior guide. It pairs awareness and energy practice with a week alone in the landscape.

courses.title: Nature Quest
courses.description: A shorter version of the Sacred Passage format, lasting from a weekend up to nine days, often arranged for a particular group or region. It suits people who want solo time in nature without the full twelve days.

courses.title: 28 & 44 Day AllOne Time Solo Wilderness Retreats
courses.description: Long solo retreats for people who have already done a Sacred Passage, taught by John P. Milton. They add Taoist energy practice, qigong and t'ai chi, and further shamanic and tantric methods to extended time alone.
